'''August 2000 Fairmont tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Fairmont, WV on 5 August 2000. [[Steven Yeager]] won it. It is known from John Tatta's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1088">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-06-fairmont-wv-8-5-00d1088/ fairmont-wv-8-5-00], DeckTech (John "Artoo-Detoo" Tatta, 6 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-06-fairmont-wv-8-5-00d1088/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 5 August 2000
* '''Site:''' Fairmont, WV
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 11
* '''Winner:''' [[Steven Yeager]]
